steam_name: Disney•Pixar Toy Story 3: The Video Game
about_the_game:
Help Buzz, Woody and the rest of the toys ensure no toy gets left behind.

Come and play to infinity…and beyond!

STORY MODE
Dive into historic adventures from the Toy Story 3 movie!

TOY BOX MODE
Play your way in the open world of Toy Box!
